reviewer: Codex, independent. Did not author component-packaging-contract v1-v6 and did not read the concurrent v6 reviewer.
summary: The checksum/device repair, exact string/type/trailer choices, declared v5-to-v6 roster, schemas.v11 pointer, and authority boundary verify. Acceptance still fails at 1 blocker and 2 SHOULD-FIX: the archive algorithm lacks payload-byte inputs and complete numeric/admission closure; the fixture map is misaddressed and does not supply atomic live outcomes; and health records do not enforce exact subject role/platform coverage.

repairVerification.claim: CLAUDE-V5-S1: all-spaces checksum mask and exact zero device fields
repairVerification.evidence: archiveProfile now computes over all eight chksum octets as 0x20, distinguishes that mask from the six-octal-digits-plus-NUL-plus-space stored layout, and defines devmajor/devminor as octal7nul of 0 with no empty-field alternative.

repairVerification.claim: CLAUDE-V5-ADV-1: frozen Codex v4 verdict folded
repairVerification.evidence: The frozen Codex v4 REJECT reproduced at 6f7ab491bddace9afa76df720fea6686f428658d8e188463dac517cc40a55c7c and is named under appliesFindingsOf.codexv4 with its actual 1 blocker, 3 SHOULD-FIX, and 0 advisory inventory.

repairVerification.claim: CODEX-V4-B1: complete tree-to-byte algorithm and owned profile capacity
repairVerification.evidence: The checksum, typeflag, UTF-8 name/link, prefix, body relation, and trailer choices are materially improved, but byteAlgorithm.inputs still contains only commitment metadata rather than file payload bytes, schema-valid mode/length values can exceed the fixed octal fields without a named profile-capacity rule, and admissionChecks does not require the complete headerLayout.

The 50-entry members object is real, but the report and FG rules address fixtureMemberMap[memberKey] rather than fixtureMemberMap.members[memberKey], several conjunctive schema cases remain unsplit, and expected outcomes contradict the live refusal taxonomy or omit required subcodes.

The standing enum, evidence conditions, and owning ride are present, but the array has no non-empty, uniqueness, or exact subject-role/platform coverage invariant, so partial or irrelevant applicability records can still conceal a required result.

repairVerification.claim: CODEX-V4-S3: frozen v3 advisories already folded at v5
repairVerification.evidence: The first-candidate guidance remains historicalized and CI-3 still defines runId as a nondeterministic custody annotation excluded from the reproducible tuple.

measurements.result: Subject matched the dispatched sha256 under Python hashlib(Path.read_bytes()), mode was 0444, and predecessor plus both permitted frozen verdicts matched their dispatched digests.

Duplicate-key-rejecting JSON parses passed for v5 and v6. All 14 recordedInputs governing-source sha256 values reproduced from live bytes. The DR-120 row was exact and unique, and the carried file-02 lines 86-121 were byte-for-line exact at their pins.

A recursive value diff found 68 changed leaves: acceptanceTests 2, appliesFindingsOf 6, archiveProfile 12, artifact 1, basedOn 3, conformanceReport 23, fixtureGeneration 3, honestyRepairsFromV5 1, namedOpenDecisions 4, outputContract 2, reviewGuidance 10, and version 1. Every change was at or below a path named by basedOn.method's closed roster; no silent v5-to-v6 path was found.

The headerLayout is contiguous from byte 0 through byte 511; the all-spaces checksum mask, exact typeflags, UTF-8 NFC name/link rules, 155-NUL prefix, file length/hash relation, NUL body padding, and exact two-block-at-EOF trailer all verify. Residual closure fails: inputs names only TreeCommitment.entries and no payload-byte map; octal7nul and octal11nul have maxima 2,097,151 and 8,589,934,591 while schemas.v11 leaves mode as an unconstrained octal string and file length as an uncapped integer; OD-P2 names only name/link capacities; and admissionChecks omits an all-fields-equal-headerLayout rule.

schemas.v11 has 45 requires strings. v6 has 50 records under fixtureMemberMap.members: all 45 class/ordinal pairs are present, TC-NAME.4 is split into two arms, and four conditional/scope arms are added. However the report/FG prose addresses the four fixtureMemberMap top-level metadata keys instead of .members; all 9 RJ-2 records omit the required live subcode, TC-PATH.12 invents RJ-3/ENTRYPOINT_ABSENT although RJ-3 has no subcodes, TC-NAME.4.after names no live refusal code, and TC-SIG.C-ENVELOPE repeats the whole two-arm conditional while C-LOCK repeats its lock arm.

The report now has a four-value standing enum, digest evidence for executed results, and an AT-4/ID-DEP-P4 ride for non-executed results. The array definition does not require at least one member, uniqueness, membership in the subject's role/platform set, or exact coverage of that set; only a missing array or a member missing standing is declared report-invalid.

The subject remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW, DO-NOT-SEAL, and binds NOTHING. It does not positively mark DR-120 or DR-103 complete, authorize docs/v2/implementation/, or choose a packager, build tool, language toolchain, CLI, or tar implementation. OD-P2 now correctly identifies schemas.v11 rather than schemas.v2.

blockers.title: opensip-archive-profile.1 is still not a total, closed payload-to-byte and admission algorithm
detail: byteAlgorithm.inputs names only the ordered TreeCommitment.entries. A file entry supplies length and sha256 metadata, not the payload bytes that must be emitted. bodyRules.file says to write bytes satisfying those values, which is a postcondition, not an algorithm for obtaining bytes. S-1-COLLECT mentions a closed input set elsewhere, but no byteAlgorithm input joins a path to those collected bytes. The claimed tree-to-byte function therefore cannot produce a nonempty regular-file body from its stated inputs.

The fixed numeric fields impose additional profile capacities that OD-P2 does not own. octal7nul can encode at most 2,097,151 and octal11nul at most 8,589,934,591, while schemas.v11 permits an octal-string mode and an uncapped integer file length. encoding's generic 'Overflow is typed adapter non-success' supplies neither stable refusal identities nor boundary rules, and OD-P2/profileCapacityDeclaredHere plus byteAlgorithm.doesNotMintSchemaCaps enumerate only name[100] and linkname[100]. Schema-valid mode/length inputs therefore have an unrecorded or non-portable disposition.

The emitted headerLayout is byte-specific, but admissionChecks never says that every header field must equal the headerLayout derived from the commitment. Its listed checks omit the decoded size field, uid, gid, mtime, uname, gname, devmajor, devminor, the 12-byte header pad, and canonical numeric spelling. For example, a nonzero uid or non-NUL header pad with a recomputed checksum is outside the emitter profile but is not rejected by any listed admission check. The purported exact profile remains a family on its consumption side.

The cross-implementation test is internally unexecutable as written. FG-7 requires two independent adapters, while AT-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY and AT-8 require those adapters to have identical CI-1 pins; CI-1 includes the adapter version digest. Distinct adapter implementations cannot normally share that pin, so the test cannot demonstrate that independent implementations converge on the same profile bytes.
blockers.impact: The immutable archive and archiveDigest are central OC-2/OC-7 outputs and CI-3 asserts archive byte identity. A producer cannot execute the stated algorithm from its declared inputs for ordinary file trees, some live-schema-valid trees have no exact portable outcome, and an admission implementation can accept noncanonical headers. This leaves the substance of CODEX-V4-B1 open.
blockers.minimumRepair: Make the algorithm input include an exact payload-byte map keyed by normalized tree path (or normatively join the S-1 collected byte set), require each file body to be exactly that mapped value, and verify its commitment length/hash before emission. Declare exact mode/size capacity refusals and boundary fixtures at OD-P2, or bind corresponding schema caps through an authorized successor. Make admission derive the canonical 512-byte header and compare every octet, including size, fixed metadata, numeric spelling, prefix, and pad. Define a fixed tree-plus-payload conformance vector whose expected archive bytes/digest are independent of adapter identity, so two adapters may keep distinct CI-1 adapter pins while proving the same profile output.

shouldFix.title: fixtureMemberMap is populated but is not an addressable one-fixture/one-outcome coverage contract
detail: The 50 records live at fixtureMemberMap.members, but fixtureClassCoverage says memberKey is a 'fixtureMemberMap key' and resolves fixtureMemberMap[memberKey].ride; FG-1 and FG-6 use the same wrong level. The four actual top-level keys are discipline, schemaRequiresCount, mapKeyCount, and members. Consequently the report shape cannot address any TC-* record as written and cannot perform its promised missing/duplicate/ride validation.

FG-2 and schemas.v11 require each fixture to state exactly one refusal code plus subcode when that code has subcodes. All nine TC-NAME refusal records instead say only refuse:RJ-2 even though RJ-2 has ten live subcodes. Several source strings contain distinct cases that require different subcodes, including reserved name versus alias forms, alias collision versus alias-shadows-live, and parent-linkage collision versus unknown/cyclic parent. One evidence record and one expected value cannot prove those cases while fixtureGenerator also requires exactly one controlled invalidity.

Other expected values are not members of the live taxonomy: TC-PATH.12 says RJ-3/ENTRYPOINT_ABSENT although RJ-3 defines no subcodes, and TC-NAME.4.after says typed-stale-alias although schemas.v11 defines no such refusal identity. TC-SIG.C-ENVELOPE copies the complete two-arm conditionalRequires string, including the lock arm, while TC-SIG.C-LOCK maps that arm again; the envelope record therefore is not an isolated arm. TC-CLOSURE.2 records RJ-5 but has no field proving the separately required typed remediation.
shouldFix.impact: A conformance report cannot demonstrate complete, nonduplicated member coverage or compare actual outcomes to one exact live expectation. The new cardinality is useful inventory, but it does not fulfill FG-1/FG-2/FG-6 or close CODEX-V4-S1.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Change every normative/report reference to fixtureMemberMap.members[memberKey]. Split conjunctive requires strings and conditional prose into atomic fixture keys until each key represents one controlled case and one expected result. Use the exact live refusal code/subcode, or record an explicit owning blocked ride where the schema has not minted one; do not invent subcodes. Give the remediation obligation its own checkable field/evidence. Then recompute and enforce the closed key count.

shouldFix.title: Health standing is typed but still lacks an exact subject role/platform coverage invariant
shouldFix.detail: The repair adds the right standing enum, evidence requirement, and owner ride, and AT-4 says a report with no applicability record fails. But the report shape declares only that the applicability array must exist and each present member must have a standing. It does not reject an empty array, duplicates, an unrelated role/platform member, or omission of the subject's actual role/platform while some other member is present. The standalone subject shape does not even carry role. Thus a partial or irrelevant record can meet every explicit report-invalid condition while the required health result remains absent.
shouldFix.impact: OC-6 requires health applicability at each role/platform. Without a closed join to the report subject and manifest, the evidence/ride rules govern records that happen to be present but do not prove completeness, leaving CODEX-V4-S2 partially open.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Define the exact required applicability key set. For a per-platform report, include the manifest role in subject and require exactly one unique member matching subject.role plus subject.platform; if the report is meant to cover multiple alternatives, define and enforce that complete cross-product instead. Reject empty, missing, extra, and duplicate keys, then apply the existing evidence/ride rules to every required key.

attacksAttemptedAndFailed: Checksum-mask attack: refuted. All eight chksum bytes are 0x20 during computation; the NUL appears only in the stored representation. devmajor/devminor are unambiguously octal7nul zero.

Path/link hidden-cap attack: refuted for the two 100-byte string fields. PATH-EXCEEDS-USTAR-NAME and LINKTARGET-EXCEEDS-USTAR-LINKNAME are explicit profile non-successes, have 100/101 boundary cases, and are owned in OD-P2. CPCV6-B1 concerns separate payload, numeric-field, admission, and cross-adapter closure defects.

Typeflag/prefix/trailer attack: refuted on emission. Regular-file NUL typeflag is forbidden, prefix splitting is forbidden and prefix is 155 NUL, and the archive ends at exactly two zero blocks. CPCV6-B1 concerns the remaining non-total input and admission rules.

fixtureClassRides alternative attack: refuted. The v5 class strings are explicitly retired and no class-level 'or' producer string remains. CPCV6-S1 concerns the replacement member map's actual addressing and atomic-outcome defects.
OD-P2 stale-schema attack: refuted. It expressly points to schemas.v11 OD-1 and disclaims historical schemas.v2.
Silent v5-to-v6 mutation attack: refuted by the 68-leaf closed-roster diff.
Authority/tool-choice attack: refuted. No positive DR-120/DR-103 completion, QUALIFIED status, implementation authorization, concrete packager, toolchain, CLI, or tar implementation choice was found.
verdictBasis: REJECT: 1 blocker and 2 SHOULD-FIX. The prompt permits ACCEPT only at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
verdictStatement: This independent review rejects component-packaging-contract.v6 at the measured subject digest. It applies or seals nothing, does not mark DR-120 or DR-103 complete, does not authorize implementation, and chooses no packager, toolchain, or CLI.
coordinatorNote: Issue a successor. Preserve the verified checksum/device repair, UTF-8/typeflag/prefix/trailer choices, explicit 100-byte name/link refusals, schemas.v11 OD-P2 pointer, retired class-level map, closed delta, and authority boundary. Close the payload/numeric/admission archive gaps, normalize fixture members to atomic live outcomes at the correct JSON path, and enforce exact health role/platform coverage.
